props.name: close
props.description: Show a close button to dismiss the alert.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the close button. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.close`.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text. Overridden by the `description` slot if provided.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the leading side.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text. Overridden by the `title` slot if provided.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the variant's resolved foreground.

slots.name: close
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom close icons can match the variant's resolved foreground.
